title: The install queue's 30-minute ceiling is a fixed constant, not size-derived - it fires on real downloads
description: downloadService.js's safety timeout calls itself 'longer than any single model download'. That is false for the 20-26GB deps we ship: it fired on the live minimax-h3-ref2va install on 2026-08-29 and released the chain mid-download. Make it an IDLE ceiling - reset on every progress tick.
